description: Ask Otto in plain words; Otto picks the right Otto service and answers, for one exact price. A failed answer costs nothing. Call it without x_payment to receive the quote: the chosen service’s price plus a $0.01 fee. Sign that requirement and call again with the same ask, the same price_cap_usd and the signed payload in x_payment. It answers about stocks and tokenized stocks by ticker, crypto prices by symbol, crypto news, X posts, prediction markets, DEX pools, web questions and domain lookups. An ask no Otto service fits is refused and nothing is charged. Market context only; not a recommendation. Hosted access: paid-only; each call costs the exact price its payment request quotes, at most $0.11 USDC, through x402, and preserves the free allowance.

ask.description: The question in plain words, for example "NVDA stock profile" or "how old is uniswap.org".

price_cap_usd.description: The most this ask may cost in USD, fee included. Without it the limit is $0.11.

x_payment.description: Signed x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive the machine-actionable payment challenge, then retry with the signed payload.
